description_en: Submits a job to delete a DNA library
name: SubmitFpDBDeleteJob

parameters.help_en: The MPS queue ID, which is used to associate message notifications. You can obtain the ID from MPS console > Global Settings > MPS queue
parameters.help_zh: 管道ID，用于绑定消息通知。可以通过MPS控制台 > 全局设置 > 管道获取
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.help_en: The DNA library ID. You can obtain the ID from the response parameters of https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170149.html
parameters.help_zh: DNA库ID，可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170149.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: fp_db_id

parameters.help_en: The custom data. The value can contain letters, digits, and other characters. The maximum length is 128 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，支持中英文、数字等，最大长度128个字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

Purge: Clears the DNA library. All content in the DNA library is deleted, but the DNA library itself is not deleted.

Delete: Deletes the DNA library. DNA fingerprint libraries of new versions with a modelId in the range of [11, 14] support only the delete operation.

Default value: Purge
parameters.help_zh:
操作类型，支持类型：

Purge：清空DNA库，即删除DNA库中所有内容，不会删除DNA库。

Delete：删除DNA库，即删除此DNA库。其中，modelId在[11, 14]内的新版本指纹库仅支持删除操作。

默认值：Purge
parameters.name: del_type

JobId.description_en: The ID of the job to clear or delete the DNA library. Save this ID for use with other operations
JobId.description_zh: 清空或删除DNA库作业ID。建议您保存此ID便于后续使用其他接口时使用
